Name: Decorative Gacha Machine
Author: xxlyufi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds a decorative gacha machine to your farmhouse. Click it to randomly draw any wallpaper or flooring from the entire in-game collection — for free, as many times as you want. The machine arrives the morning after you install the mod. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and extract the 
[/color]
[code]GachaMachine[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder into 
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game via SMAPI[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]All 168 wallpapers and 80 floorings available[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No gold cost — draw as much as you want[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Arrives by mail on day one[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]1x2 tile decorative furniture[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Controller support[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher 2.0+[/color][/*]
[/list]
